name_en: Aberdeen Country Park (Aberdeen Upper Reservoir) Accessible Route
name_zh: 香港仔郊野公園(香港仔上水塘)無障礙路線
transport_start: Take public transport to "Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen" bus stop. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 95 and 971
transport_end: Take bus 95 Circular Route at the Start Point "Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen" bus stop of go to the "Shek Pak Wan" bus stop for other public transport Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 95 及 971

transport_start: Take public transport to "Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen" bus stop and walk up the Aberdeen Reservoir road for 10 minutes to reach the entrance of Aberdeen Country Park. Then walk along the path on the right hand side for 5 minutues to reach the start point of the trail. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 95 amd 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4S and 52 Minibus - Aberdeen to Shek Pai Wan
transport_end: The finishing point is located at the main dam of the Aberdeen Upper Reservoir. Visitors can walk along the Aberdeen Reservoir Road for 30 minutes to "Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen" bus stop. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 95 and 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4S and 52 Minibus - Aberdeen to Shek Pai Wan

transport_start: Take public transport to “Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen” bus stop or “Aberdeen Reservoir Road” minibus stop. Walk uphill along Aberdeen Reservoir Road to the starting point. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 595, 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4M, 4S, N4C, 52
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk about 200 m to “Wai Chai Gap Road” bus stop and take public transport to leave. Citybus route - 15

name_zh: 香港仔畔塘徑 (下水塘段)
transport_start: Take public transport to “Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen” bus stop or “Aberdeen Reservoir Road” minibus stop. Walk uphill along Aberdeen Reservoir Road to the starting point. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 595, 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4M, 4S, N4C, 52
transport_end: Walk for about 1 km towards Aberdeen from the endpoint to reach the entrance of Aberdeen Country Park. Then, continue to walk for about 500 m to the Shek Pai Wan Estate Public Transport Interchange to take public transport to leave. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4M, 4S, N4A, N4C or From the endpoint, you may continue to the second half of the Aberdeen Reservoirs Walk towards Wan Chai Gap. After arriving Wan Chai Gap, walk for about 200 m to “Wai Chai Gap Road” bus stop and take public transport to leave. Citybus route - 15

transport_start: Take public transport to "Hoy Au Lau Yue Kwong Chuen" bus stop and walk up the Aberdeen Reservoir road for 10 minutes to reach the Aberdeen Tree Centre. The start point is outside the Centre. Citybus routes - 7, 70P, 76, 95 and 971 Green Minibus routes - 4A, 4B, 4C, 4S and 52 Minibus - Aberdeen to Shek Pai Wan
transport_end: Take public transport at Wan Chai Gap Road for leaving. Citybus route - 15 and 15B

transport_start: Take public transport to Tai Mei Tuk Bus Terminus, then take a taxi to the green pavilion beside Bride's Pool Nature Trail. Green Minibus route 20R or bus route 275R (available on Sundays & public holidays only) can reach the entrance directly. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 75K and 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays.) Green Minibus routes- 20C and 20R
transport_end: Same as Start Point. Walk along Bride's Pool Road towards Plover Cove Reservoir to return to Tai Mei Tuk Country Park Management Centre, and then walk downhill to Tai Mei Tuk Bus Terminus for leaving. Take Green Minibus route 20R or bus route 275R (available on Sundays & public holidays only) at Bride's Pool Bus Stop for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 75K and 275R (275R only operate on Sunday and public holidays) Green Minibus routes – 20C and 20R

transport_start: Take a green minibus to Hoi Ha Road and get off at the starting point of Cheung Sheung Country Trail near Hau Tong Kai. Green Minibus route - 7
transport_end: From the endpoint at Yung Shue O, walk along the catchwater for about 4.5 km to the "Shui Long Wo" bus stop on Sai Sha Road to take public transport to leave. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 33R, 74R, 99, 99R, 289R and 299X Green Minibus route - 807B

transport_start: Get off at the Lo Wai Tsuen stop and walk along the path towards Shap Long for about 20 minutes to reach the entrance of the Chi Ma Wan Country Trail. New Lantao Bus route - 3M
transport_end: You can leave midway at the Chi Ma Wan Pier after a 20-minute walk from the Shap Long Irrigation Reservoir, or at the endpoint, walk for 20 minutes towards Lo Wai to reach the Lo Wai Tsuen stop and take public transportation to leave. New Lantao Bus route - 3M

transport_start: Take public transport to "Chuen Lung" bus stop and walk towards Tsuen Wan to the entrance of the trail located at Chuen Lung Barbecue Area Site No. 1. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 51 Green Minibus route - 80
transport_end: Walk from Chuen Lung Barbecue Area Site No. 1 to Chuen Lung Public Light Bus Terminus to take bus or minibus. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 51 Green Minibus route - 80

transport_start: Take public transport to "Chung Pui Barbecue Site" bust stop to reach the entrance of the Tree Walk. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays.) Green Minibus routes- 20R
transport_end: Same as starting point.

transport_start: Take public transport to "Tai Au Mun" bus stop. Get off at the roundabout of Tai Au Mun at Clearwater Bay. Walk along Clear Water Bay Road for about 1km (about 30 minutes) to Tai Hang Tun Barbecue Site at the end of the road, the tree walk starts in the barbecue site. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91 Green Minibus routes - 16, 103 and 103M
transport_end: Same as Starting point.

transport_start: Take bus route 275R to Wu Kau Tang bus terminus or Green Minibus route 20R to junction of Chi Sum Road and Wu Kau Tang Road. Then walk along Wu Kau Tang Road to the end. The start point is on the left. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays) Green Minibus route - 20R
transport_end: Return to start point and take public transport for leaving, or head to Lai Chi Wo Pier to take ferry. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays) Green Minibus route - 20R Ferry Service (Source: Transport Department ) - Ma Liu Shui to Lai Chi Wo (Depart at 09:00 on Sundays and public holidays only) - Lai Chi Wo to Ma Liu Shui (Depart at 15:30 on Sundays and public holidays only) - Tai Shui Hang to Lai Chi Wo / Kat O / Ap Chau (Tuesdays and Thursdays only, except public holidays.) Depart at 09:00 at Tai Shui Hang, pass by Lai Chi Wo and Kat O, then depart at 12:45 at Ap Chau) - Sha Tau Kok to Lai Chi Wo / Ap Chau / Kat O (No service on Tuesday (except Public Holidays)) (Depart at 08:30, 10:30, 12:30, 15:15, 17:00 at Sha Tau Kok). Note1, 2 Note1 : Passengers must obtain the valid Sha Tau Kok Closed Area Permit before boarding at Sha Tau Kok Public Pier. Note2 : Passengers should purchase return ticket together with a departure ticket while on board at Sha Tau Kok Public Pier. Tourism Closed Area Permit (Individual) could be applied through Online Application Platform of Hong Kong Police Force

transport_start: Take public transport to the "To Tei Wan" bus stop on Shek O Road. After getting off, follow the directional sign of Hong Kong Trail and walk uphill to reach Dragon’s Back. Citybus route - 9 Public Minibus route - Shau Kei Wan to and from Shek O
transport_end: Head towards Tai Tam Gap to reach Shek O Road and take public transport at the “Cape Collinson Road” bus stop. Citybus route - 9 Public Minibus route - Shau Kei Wan to and from Shek O

transport_start: Take public transport to "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop. If arriving from the Tai Po or Sha Tin direction, get off and walk along Piper’s Hill Road on the left side of the bus stop to reach the starting point. If arriving from the Kowloon direction, get off and use the pedestrian bridge to cross to the opposite sidewalk, then turn right onto Piper’s Hill Road and walk to the starting point. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 72 and 81
transport_end: Walk approximately 150 m along Piper’s Hill Road from the endpoint to Tai Po Road. From there, you can take public transportation from the "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop on the left to leave in the Kowloon direction. Alternatively, use the pedestrian bridge to cross to the opposite sidewalk and take public transportation from the "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop to head towards Tai Po or Sha Tin. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 72 and 81

transport_start: Get off at the end of the Dam of Shek Pik Reservoir, Wang Pui Road and walk along Kau Ling Chung catchwater to reach entrance at Fan Lau Tung Wan Trail. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23
transport_end: Walk from Fan Lau Tsuen along Kau Ling Chung Catchwater to Wang Pui Road and take public transport for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

transport_start: Take bus or minibus and get off at Lingnan University, Castle Peak Road (Lingnan), then turn to Fu Tei Road and walk uphill for about 20 minutes to the entrance which is next to Fu Tei Barbecue Site. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 53, 67M, 67X, 261, 267X and 960S( 267X and 960S only runs on Weekday morning) MTR Bus routes - K51 Green minibus route - 46
transport_end: Back to the start point of the Trail and walk downhill along Fu Tei Road to take public transportation.

transport_start: Take a green minibus to the “Luk Keng” minibus terminus, then walk about 350m along Bride’s Pool Road towards Kai Kuk Shue Ha to the starting point. Green Minibus route - 56K
transport_end: Walk along Bride's Pool Road from the endpoint towards Kai Kuk Shue Ha for about 1 km to reach “Luk Keng” minibus terminus to leave. Green Minibus route - 56K

name_en: High Island Geo Trail - Biu Tsim Kok Section
name_zh: 萬宜地質步道 - 標尖角段
transport_start: Take Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) and alight at Sheung Yiu bus stop. Walk along Tai Mong Tsai Road until you reach the junction, then turn right onto Sai Kung Man Yee Road and continue towards the starting point. The distance from the bus stop to the starting point is about 9 km; or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from Pak Tam Chung to the East Dam of High Island Reservoir.
transport_end: Walk about 9 km along Sai Kung Man Yee Road and Tai Mong Tsai Road to Sheung Yiu bus stop. Take KMB routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays); or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from the East Dam of High Island Reservoir to Pak Tam Chung, followed by public transportation.

name_en: High Island Geo Trail - East Dam Section
name_zh: 萬宜地質步道 - 東壩段
transport_start: Take Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) and alight at Sheung Yiu bus stop. Walk along Tai Mong Tsai Road until you reach the junction, then turn right onto Sai Kung Man Yee Road and continue towards the starting point. The distance from the bus stop to the starting point is about 9 km; or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from Pak Tam Chung to the East Dam of High Island Reservoir.
transport_end: Walk about 9 km along Sai Kung Man Yee Road and Tai Mong Tsai Road to Sheung Yiu bus stop. Take KMB routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays); or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from the East Dam of High Island Reservoir to Pak Tam Chung, followed by public transportation.

name_en: High Island Geo Trail - Po Pin Chau Section
name_zh: 萬宜地質步道 - 破邊洲段
transport_start: Take Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) and alight at Sheung Yiu bus stop. Walk along Tai Mong Tsai Road until you reach the junction, then turn right onto Sai Kung Man Yee Road and continue towards the starting point. The distance from the bus stop to the starting point is about 9 km; or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from Pak Tam Chung to the East Dam of High Island Reservoir.
transport_end: Walk about 9 km along Sai Kung Man Yee Road and Tai Mong Tsai Road to Sheung Yiu bus stop. Take KMB routes no. 94, 96R or 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays); or Take Green minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) from the East Dam of High Island Reservoir to Pak Tam Chung, followed by public transportation.

transport_start: Alight at "Ng Fai Tin" stop on Clear Water Bay Road and cross the road to reach the starting point. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91 Green Minibus routes - 16, 103 and 103M
transport_end: Take Green Minibus route 16 at "Po Toi O" stop near the endpoint to leave, or walk approximately 2 km to Clear Water Bay Bus Terminus to take public transport. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91 Green Minibus routes - 16, 103 and 103M

transport_start: Take public transport to Ho Pui Tsuen. Walk about 30 minutes from Ho Pui Tsuen to Ho Pui Reservoir Family Walk. Green Minibus route - 71
transport_end: Same as start point.

transport_start: Get off at Hok Tau Management Centre and walk for 1 minute to reach the entrance. Green Minibus route - 52B
transport_end: Walk along Hok Tau Road to reach entrance of Hok Tau Wai for leaving. Green Minibus route - 52B

transport_start: Take public transport to "Hok Tau Wai" and walk along Hok Tau Road to reach Dam at Hok Tau Reservoir Green Minibus route - 52B
transport_end: Walk along Hok Tau Road to reach Hok Tau Wai for leaving. Green Minibus route - 52B

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 1) The Peak to Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road
name_zh: 港島徑(第一段)山頂至薄扶林水塘道
transport_start: Take the Peak Tram to the Peak Tower or take public transport to the public transport terminus at the Peak, then walk along Peak Road to the starting point at Lugard Road. Citybus routes - X15 and 15 Green Minibus route - 1
transport_end: Walk along Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road for about 1 km to Pok Fu Lam Road and take public transport to leave. Citybus routes - Various routes to Admiralty, Mong Kok, and other locations Green Minibus routes - Various routes to Admiralty, Kennedy Town, and other locations

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 2) Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road to Peel Rise
name_zh: 港島徑(第二段)薄扶林水塘道至貝璐道
transport_start: Take public transport to "Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road" bus stop or minibus stop. Walk for about 1 km along Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road to the starting point. Citybus routes - Various routes from Admiralty, Mong Kok, and other locations Green Minibus routes – Various routes from Admiralty, Kennedy Town, and other locations
transport_end: Walk from the endpoint for about 1.6 km via Peel Rise, Aberdeen Reservoir Road, and Aberdeen Main Road to Aberdeen Bus Terminus and take public transport to leave. Citybus routes - Various routes to Admiralty, Kowloon Bay, Cheung Sha Wan, and other locations Green Minibus routes - Various routes to Admiralty, Quarry Bay, and other locations

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 3) Peel Rise to Wan Chai Gap
name_zh: 港島徑(第三段)貝璐道至灣仔峽
transport_start: Take public transport to "Tsung Man Street" bus stop or “Aberdeen Reservoir Road” minibus stop. Walk uphill along Peel Rise for about 1.2 km to the starting point. Citybus routes - Various routes from Central, Causeway Bay, Mong Kok, and other locations Green Minibus routes - Various routes from Causeway Bay, Wan Chai, and other locations
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk uphill along Aberdeen Reservoir Road for about 700 m to “Wan Chai Gap Road” bus stop and take public transport to leave. Citybus route - 15

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 4) Wan Chai Gap to Wong Nai Chung Gap
name_zh: 港島徑(第四段)灣仔峽至黃泥涌峽
transport_start: Take public transport to "Wan Chai Gap Road" bus stop. Walk about 650 m along Aberdeen Reservoir Road via Wan Chai Gap Park to the starting point. Citybus route - 15
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk about 120 m along Tai Tam Reservoir Road to “Tai Tam Reservoir Road” bus stop and take public transport to leave. Citybus routes - 1M, 6, 41A and 76

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 5) Wong Nai Chung Gap to Mount Parker Road
name_zh: 港島徑(第五段)黃泥涌峽至柏架山道
transport_start: Take public transport to "Wong Nai Chung Reservoir Park" bus stop or "Tai Tam Reservoir Road" minibus stop. Then, follow the steps ahead to Tai Tam Reservoir Road, which is the starting point of Section 5 of the Hong Kong Trail. Citybus routes - 1M, 6, 41A, 63, 66, 76, A17 Green Minibus route – 5
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk approximately 3 km along Mount Parker Road to King's Road, where you can take public transport to leave; alternatively, from the junction of King's Road and Mount Parker Road, walk about 350 m to Tai Koo MTR Station Exit B to depart by MTR. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes – Various routes to Yuen Long, Tuen Mun, Yau Tong, and other locations Citybus routes – Various routes to Admiralty, Causeway Bay, Tuen Mun, Kowloon Bay, and other locations Green Minibus routes – Various routes to North Point, Aberdeen, Mong Kok, and other locations

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 6) Mount Parker Road to Tai Tam Road
name_zh: 港島徑(第六段)柏架山道至大潭道
transport_start: Take the MTR to Tai Koo MTR Station and exit from Exit B. Walk for about 350 m to the junction of King's Road and Mount Parker Road. Alternatively, take public transport to the section of King’s Road near Mount Parker Road. Then, walk along Mount Parker Road uphill for about 3 km to the starting point at Quarry Gap. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes – Various routes from Yuen Long, Tuen Mun, Yau Tong, and other locations Citybus routes – Various routes from Admiralty, Causeway Bay, Tuen Mun, Kowloon Bay, and other locations Green Minibus routes – Various routes from North Point, Aberdeen, Mong Kok, and other locations
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk to the junction of trails toward Shek O and Tai Tam Harbour near the starting point of Hong Kong Trail (Section 7). Proceed in the direction of Tai Tam Harbour and walk for about 1 km to reach the "Tai Tam Reservoir (North)" bus stop or “Tai Tam Road, Tai Tam Dam (North)” minibus stop, where you can take public transport to leave. Citybus routes - 14, 314 Green Minibus routes – 16A, 16M and 16X

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 7) Tai Tam Road to To Tei Wan
name_zh: 港島徑(第七段)大潭道至土地灣
transport_start: Take public transport to “Tai Tam Reservoir (North)” bus stop or “Tai Tam Road, Tai Tam Dam (North)” minibus stop. Walk for about 30 m towards Tai Tam Harbour until you reach a staircase. Go down the stairs and continue walking approximately 1 km towards Shek O to reach the starting point. Citybus routes - 14 and 314 Green Minibus routes - 16A, 16M and 16X
transport_end: Take public transport to leave from “To Tei Wan” bus stop. Citybus routes - 9 and X9

name_en: Hong Kong Trail (Section 8) To Tei Wan to Tai Long Wan
name_zh: 港島徑(第八段)土地灣至大浪灣
transport_start: Take public transport to "To Tei Wan" bus stop. The starting point of Hong Kong Trail (Section 8) is located next to the bus stop. Citybus route - 9
transport_end: Take public transport from the endpoint to leave. Citybus route - 9 Red minibus between Shau Kei Wan and Shek O

transport_start: Alight at “Sunway Gardens, King's Road” or “Quarry Bay Street, King’s Road” bus station. Walk along the King's Road to the entrance of Mount Parker Road beside Quarry Bay Municipal Services Building, walk uphill for about 45 minutes to the sign of Quarry Bay Management Centre, and then turn left to the side-road, a footpath at the right is the starting point of Hong Pak Country Trail. MTR - Quarry Bay MTR Station Exit A Citybus routes - A12, N8, N8X, NA12, 2, 2A, 8H, 18X, 19P, 77, 77A, 81, 81A, 82, 85, 85A, 99, 302A, 307P, 678 and 722 Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 102, 102P, 106, 106A, 106P, 110, 116, 302A, 307P, 606, 606A and 678 Green Minibus routes - 33 and 68
transport_end: Linked to the Section 2 of Wilson Trail at the final section and then go downhill. Follow the path that skirts Kornhill Mansions, and where it meets a road turn downhill. Continue down Greig Road to King's Road. Walk along east continually to reach the Taikoo MTR Station Exit B. MTR - Taikoo MTR Station Citybus routes - A12, N8, N8X, N122, NA12, 2, 2A, 8H, 18X, 19P, 77, 77A, 81, 81A, 82, 85, 85A, 99, 102, 102P, 106P, 106, 302A, 307P, 606, 606A, 608, 678, 682, 682B, 694S, 722 and 988 Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 102, 102P, 106, 106A, 106P, 110, 116, 302A, 307P, 606, 606A and 678 Green Minibus routes - 32, 32A, 33 and 68

transport_start: Get off at "World Wide Gardens" bus stop and then take a walk about 2 minutes to reach the entrance of the Hung Mui Kuk Nature Trail located at the Hung Mui Kuk Barbecue Site. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 80, 85, 85B, 86A, 87B, 89B, 170, 182, 281M, N170 , N182 , N281 Citybus routes - 170, N170, 182
transport_end: Same as Starting Point.

transport_start: Take public transport to "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 72 and 81
transport_end: Same as Start Point.

transport_start: Take public transport to "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop. Walk along Kam Shan Road towards Kowloon Byewash Reservoir, and you will see the entrance of Tree Walk. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 72 and 81
transport_end: Return to starting point and take public transport for leaving.

name_en: Kap Lung Ancient Trail Country Trail
transport_start: Get off at Tai Mo Shan Country Park, walk along the pedestrian path for 100m to the entrance of the trail. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 51 (Circular)
transport_end: Walk along Pat Heung Catchwater to "Lui Kung Tin Tsuen" bus stop for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 51 (Circular) Green Minibus routes - 72

transport_start: Take public transport to "Shui Long Wo" bus stop along Sai Sha Road. The entrance of the Tree Walk is just beside the carpark. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 99, 99R and 299X (99R runs only on Sundays and public holidays) Green Minibus route - 807B
transport_end: Same as starting point.

transport_start: Get off at the Sha Tsui bus station at Keung Shan Road. Walk along Wang Pui Road and Lantau Trail Section 8 for around 1 hour to reach the starting point of the trail. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2 and 11
transport_end: Take public transport at Tai O Road for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 11 and 21

transport_start: Take public transport to Wu Kau Tang Green Minibus terminus located at Chi Sum Road. Then walk from Wu Kau Tang to Lai Chi Wo for 2 hours to reach the start point. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays.) Green Minibus routes - 20R
transport_end: Visitors can return to Start Point and take public transport for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 275R (275R only runs on Sundays and public holidays.) Green Minibus routes - 20R Ferry Service - Ma Liu Shui to Lai Chi Wo (Depart at 09:00 on Sundays and public holidays only) - Lai Chi Wo to Ma Liu Shui (Depart at 15:30 on Sundays and public holidays only) - Tai Shui Hang to Lai Chi Wo / Kat O / Ap Chau (Tuesdays and Thursdays only, except public holidays.) Depart at 09:00 at Tai Shui Hang, pass by Lai Chi Wo and Kat O, then depart at 12:45 at Ap Chau) - Sha Tau Kok to Lai Chi Wo / Ap Chau / Kat O (No service on Tuesday (except Public Holidays)) (Depart at 08:30, 10:30, 12:30, 15:15, 17:00 at Sha Tau Kok). Note1, 2 Note1 : Passengers must obtain the valid Sha Tau Kok Closed Area Permit before boarding at Sha Tau Kok Public Pier. Note2 : Passengers should purchase return ticket together with a departure ticket while on board at Sha Tau Kok Public Pier. Tourism Closed Area Permit (Individual) could be applied through Online Application Platform of Hong Kong Police Force Transport Department web page

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 1) Mui Wo to Nam Shan
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第一段) 梅窩至南山
transport_start: Take First Ferry at Pier 6 in Central or take New Lantao Bus route 3M in Tung Chung to Mui Wo Ferry Pier.
transport_end: Take public transport at "Nam Shan Campsite" bus stop along South Lantau Road for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 3M and 4

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 10) Shui Hau to Cheung Sha
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第十段) 水口至長沙
transport_start: Take public transport to "Shui Hau Village (East)" bus stop. After getting off, walk along South Lantau Road for about 2 minutes to the starting point. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23
transport_end: Turn right at the distance post L113 and walk for about 20 minutes to South Lantau Road, then take public transport from "Cheung Sha Bridge" bus stop to leave. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 11) Cheung Sha to Pui O
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第十一段) 長沙至貝澳
transport_start: Take public transport to "Cheung Sha Bridge" bus stop on South Lantau Road. After getting off, walk approximately 50 meters along South Lantau Road to a pavilion, then turn left and walk for about 20 minutes to reach the starting point at distance post L113. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23
transport_end: Walk for about one minute along South Lantau Road to "Lo Uk Tsuen" bus stop to take public transport to leave. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2 and 3M

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 12) Pui O to Mui Wo
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第十二段) 貝澳至梅窩
transport_start: Alight at "Lo Uk Tsuen" bus stop. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2 and 3M
transport_end: Take First Ferry at Mui Wo Ferry Pier to Pier 6 in Central or take New Lantao Bus route no. 3M from Mui Wo Ferry Pier to Tung Chung.

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 2) Nam Shan to Pak Kung Au
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第二段) 南山至伯公坳
transport_start: Take public transport to "Nam Shan Campsite" bus stop. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 3M and 4
transport_end: : Take public transport at "Pak Kung Au" bus stop at Tung Chung Road for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 3M, 11 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 3) Pak Kung Au to Ngong Ping
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第三段) 伯公坳至昂坪
transport_start: Take public transport to "Pak Kung Au" bus stop. New Lantao Bus routes - 3M, 11 and 23
transport_end: Walk through the archway and tea garden and reach the Ngong Ping bus terminus. New Lantao Bus routes - 2 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 4) Ngong Ping to Sham Wat Road
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第四段) 昂坪至深屈道
transport_start: Take public transport to Ngong Ping and walk through the tea garden to reach the Starting Point. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 21 and 23 Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car
transport_end: Take public transport at "Sham Wat Road" bus stop. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 5) Sham Wat Road to Man Cheung Po
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第五段) 深屈道至萬丈布
transport_start: Take public transport to ‘Sham Wat Road’ bus stop and walk 1 minute to the starting point located at the junction of Sham Wat Road and Keung Shan Road . New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2 (To Mui Wo), and 11, 23 (To Tung Chung) New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 11, 21 (To Tai O) New Lantao Bus routes – 2, 21, 23 (To Ngong Ping)
transport_end: Take public transport at ‘Lung Chai’ bus stop, Tai O Road for leaving New Lantao Bus routes – 1 (To Tung Chung or Tai O),11 (To Mui Wo or Tai O) and 21 (To Ngong Ping or Tai O)

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 6) Man Cheung Po to Tai O
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第六段) 萬丈布至大澳
transport_start: Take public transport to "Lung Chai" bus stop and walk along Keung Shan Catchwater to Ng Yuen, and then walk along the Lantau Trail to Man Cheung Po Start Point. New Lantao Bus routes - 1 and 11
transport_end: Take public transport at "Tai O" bus terminus for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 1 and 11

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 7) Tai O to Kau Ling Chung
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第七段) 大澳至狗嶺涌
transport_start: Take public transport to "Tai O" bus terminus and walk towards Yim Tin Pok to reach the starting point next to the Leung Uk Children's Playground, Tai O. New Lantao Bus routes - 1 and 11
transport_end: Walk along Kau Ling Chung Catchwater for about 1 hour to Shek Pik Wang Pui Road and then take public transport to leave. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 8) Kau Ling Chung to Shek Pik
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第八段) 狗嶺涌至石壁
transport_start: Alight at "Sha Tsui" bus station and walk along catchwater for 1 hour to reach Kau Ling Chung. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23
transport_end: New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

name_en: Lantau Trail (Section 9) Shek Pik to Shui Hau
name_zh: 鳳凰徑(第九段) 石壁至水口
transport_start: Take public transport to "Sha Tsui" bus stop. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23
transport_end: Take public transport at "Shui Hau Village (East)" bus stop for leaving. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 11 and 23

transport_start: Get off at the junction of Lau Shui Heung Road and Hok Tau Road. Walk 750 m along Lau Shui Heung Road to the entrance of Lau Shui Heung Country Trail. Green Minibus route - 52B
transport_end: Walk 1.6 km along Lau Shui Heung Road and Hok Tau Road to Hok Tau Wai and take public transport to leave. Green Minibus route - 52B

transport_start: Take green minibus at Sheung Shui Station and get off at the green minibus terminal at Lin Ma Hang Village. Walk about 100 m to the starting point of the Lin Ma Hang Country Trail. Green minibus route – 59K (Take the one towards Lin Ma Hang at Sheung Shui MTR Station) Please note that starting from 24 January 2025, the Government opened a specified section of road within the Frontier Closed Area (FCA) near Lin Ma Hang Village (Wang Lek to the entrance of the Lin Ma Hang Village), by exempting the requirement to apply for a Closed Area Permit for the public travelling by green minibus passing through that section of road. Visitors can travel to and from Lin Ma Hang Village and Robin’s Nest Country Park directly by green minibus through the abovementioned section of road within the FCA. The exemption is only applicable to persons travelling by green minibus through that section of road within the FCA, but does not apply to those taking private vehicles, taxis or other vehicles, or using other means of travel such as walking or cycling, without a valid Closed Area Permit. Visitors who would like to travel to and from Lin Ma Hang Village on foot may use the connecting path next to the FCA. The connecting path is a hillside footpath outside the FCA. It takes about 20 minutes of uphill and downhill hike. For more information on the opening of the FCA near Lin Ma Hang Village, please refer to the relevant press release .
transport_end: Return to starting point to leave (2.6km, 1.5hr), or continue to the Robin’s Nest Country Trail and arrive at Shan Tsui (~5.3km, ~2.5 hours hike), then take public transport at Tam Shui Hang Station. Green minibus route - 55K Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route – 78K, 277A, 78S (Special Timetable)

transport_start: Take a bus that pass through the Lion Rock Tunnel, get off at “World Wide Gardens” bus stop and then walk about 2 minutes to the starting point of the Lion Rock Historic Walk at the Hung Mui Kuk Barbecue Site. Bus Routes - 80, 80A, 80P, 81C, 81S, 85B, 86A, 87B, 89B, 281B, 281M, 170, 182, N170, N182, N281
transport_end: At the “Shui Chuen O Estate Yuet Chuen House” bus stop and leave by bus; or walk 10 minutes to Sha Tin Wai Station and leave by MTR. Bus Routes - 287P, 287X, 288, 288A, 288B, 288C, 682B, 982X Green Minibus Routes - 812, 812A MTR - Sha Tin Wai Station

transport_start: After alighting at "Anderson Road" or " Good Hope School" stop, walk along Fei Ngo Shan Road and turn to Clear Water Bay Road for a 45-minute walk to Starting Point Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91, 91M, 92, and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 1, 1A, 11, 11B and 104 Public Minibus routes - Mongkok to Sai Kung, Kwun Tong to Sai Kung
transport_end: For return trip, walk along the MacLehose Trail Section 5 and take public transport at the Shek Lei Pui Reservoir bus stop for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 72 and 81 Or you can walk along Lung Yan Road for 45-minute to reach Phoenix House bus station, there are many buses to choose from. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 33, 33B, 38, 40, 40P, 42C, 61X, 62X, 86, 86A, 87B, 214, 258D, 259D, 268C, 269C, 290, 290A, 290X, X42C

transport_start: From Pak Ngan Heung: Go to Mui Wo by First Ferry or New Lantao Bus, walk to Pak Ngan Heung, and then go ahead along the Olympic Trail; or from Pak Mong Village: Take New Lantao Bus at Tung Chung Town Centre and get off at the intersection of Pak Mong Village, Cheung Tung Road, then go ahead along the Olympic Trail.
transport_end: Return to A Po Long from the finishing point, go to Pak Ngan Heung or Pak Mong Village along the Olympic Trail, and then change to other means of transport. First Ferry New Lantao Bus routes - 3M and 36

transport_start: Take Green Minibus route no. 56K at Fanling Station and get off at the Luk Keng terminus. Walk along Bride's Pool Road to Luk Keng Road, then turn left towards Luk Keng Wong Uk. At the end of Luk Keng Road, take the path to the left of the village houses and walk about 450 metres to reach the Luk Keng (Wong Uk) public toilet. At the three-way junction in front of the public toilet, take the right-hand path beside the toilet. After walking uphill for about 200 metres, you will reach the starting point of the Luk Keng War Relics Trail.
transport_end: From the endpoint, go back to the Luk Keng terminus of the Green Minibus route no. 56K along the same route to leave.

transport_start: Take the village bus and get off at the end of Sai Kung Sai Wan Road. Village Bus - NR29
transport_end: Take green minibus to Sai Kung at end point or walk along "Yi Ting" at Pak Tam Road towards Pak Tam Chung for 4 minutes to reach bus stop for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9

transport_start: Get off at "Tai Au Mun" bus stop, Clear Water Bay Road, and walk for about 20 minutes along Clear Water Bay Road to reach Tai Hang Tun entrance. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 91 Green Minibus routes - 16, 103 and 103M
transport_end: Walk for about 30 minutes along Lung Ha Wan Road back to Tai Au Mun Road and take public transport for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 91 Green Minibus routes - 16, 103 and 103M

transport_start: Get off at the minibus terminus at Chuen Lung Village and walk about 30 minutes to reach the entrance. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 51 Green Minibus routes - 80
transport_end: Along Shing Mun Forest Road and take a 15 minutes walk to reach Pineapple Dam. Take the Green Minibus route no. 82 to Tsuen Wan, or continue the walk for 20 minutes to "Ho Fung College" Bus Stop at Wo Yi Hop Road and take public transport to leave. Ho Fung College KMB - 32, 36, 40X, 46P, 46X, 47X, 48X, 73X, 278X, N36, 40P, 46P, 47A, 234C, 273C, 273P, 278P Green Minibus - 94, 312, 403, 403A, 403X, 94S (94S only runs on Sundays and public holidays. )

transport_start: Take public transport to Hang On Estate or Yiu On Estate. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 40X, 43X, 81C, 85K, 85K, 85M, 85S, 87D, 87P, 87R, 89C, 89D, 89S, 97, 99, 274P, 281X, 287D, 287R, 680, 681, 680X, 681P, 980X, 981P, N680, N681, N86 and R287 Citybus route - 680, 680X, 681, 681P, 682, 980X, 981P and N680 Village minibus route - NR84 (MOSTown or Yiu On Estate in Ma On Shan to Ma On Shan Country Park Stop.)
transport_end: Take a 10 minutes walk from Tai Shui Tseng, walk along Po Lo Che Road to reach Hiram's Highway for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 92 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays.) Citybus routes - 792M Green Minibus routes - 1, 1A, 12 , 101M and 3

transport_start: Take public transport to Hang On Estate or Yiu On Estate. Then walk uphill along Ma On Shan Tsuen Road (near the roundabout of Ma On Shan Road) for 30 minutes to reach Ma On Shan Barbecue Site. Kowloon Moter Bus (KMB) routes - 40X, 43X, 81C, 85K, 85K, 85M, 85S, 87D, 87P, 87R, 89C, 89D, 89S, 97, 99, 274P, 281X, 287D, 287R, 680, 681, 680X, 681P, 980X, 981P, N680, N681, N86 and R287 Citybus route - 680, 680X, 681, 681P, 682, 980X, 981P and N680 Village minibus route - NR84 (MOSTown or Yiu On Estate in Ma On Shan to Ma On Shan Country Park Stop.)
transport_end: Same as Starting Point.

transport_start: Take public transport to "Sam Mun Tsai" bus stop. Then follow the waymark and walk for 30 minutes to reach the start point. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 74K Green Minibus route - 20K
transport_end: Visitors should walk back to Sam Mun Tsai to take public transport for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 74K Green Minibus route - 20K

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 1)Pak Tam Chung to Long Ke
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第一段)北潭涌至浪茄
transport_start: Take public transport to "Sheung Yiu" bus stop, or take green minibus and alight at the junction of Tai Mong Tsai Road and Pak Tam Road. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 94 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays) Green Minibus - 7 and 9
transport_end: Go back to High Island Reservoir (East Dam) to take Green Minibus route 9A (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) to Pak Tam Chung bus terminus, or go to Sai Wan Pavilion to take Residents' Service route NR29 to Sai Kung Town Hall.

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 10) Tin Fu Tsai to Tuen Mun
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第十段) 田夫仔至屯門
transport_start: Take public transport to "Sham Tseng Village" bus stop. From Sham Tseng, walk for about one and a half hour to Tin Fu Tsai via Tsing Fai Tong. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 52X, 53, 234A and 234B Green Minibus route - 96 and 308M
transport_end: Walk from Hoh Fuk Tong to nearby Hoh Fuk Tong College Bus Stop, Pui To Light Rail Station or Tuen Mun MTR Station. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 53, 67M, 67X, 261

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 2) Long Ke to Pak Tam Au
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第二段)浪茄至北潭凹
transport_start: Take Green Minibus route no. 9A (only on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) from Pak Tam Chung bus terminus to High Island Reservoir (East Dam) and walk to Long Ke, or take Residents' Service route NR29 from Sai Kung Town Hall to Sai Wan Pavilion and then walk to Long Ke.
transport_end: Take public transport at Pak Tam Au for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays) Green minibus route - 7

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 3) Pak Tam Au to Kei Ling Ha
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第三段)北潭凹至企嶺下
transport_start: Take public transport to "Pak Tam Au" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays) Green minibus route - 7
transport_end: Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 99, 99R and 299X (99R only runs on Sundays & Public Holidays)

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 4) Kei Ling Ha to Tate's Cairn
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第四段) 企嶺下至大老山
transport_start: Take public transport to "Shui Long Wo" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 99, 99R and 299X (99R only runs on Sundays & Public Holidays)
transport_end: Walk along Fei Ngo Shan Road and turn to Clear Water Bay Road for a 45-minute walk to "Anderson Road" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91, 91M, 92 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green minibus route - 73

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 5) Tate's Cairn to Tai Po Road
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第五段) 大老山至大埔公路
transport_start: After alight at "Anderson Road" bus stop, walk along Fei Ngo Shan Road and turn to Clear Water Bay Road for a 45-minute walk to Starting Point Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 91, 91M, 92 及 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays)
transport_end: Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 72 and 81

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 6) Tai Po Road to Shing Mun
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第六段)大埔公路至城門
transport_start: Take public transport to "Shek Lei Pui Reservoir" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 72 and 81
transport_end: Take the Green Minibus route no. 82 at Pineapple Dam of Shing Mun Reservoir to Tsuen Wan, or continue the walk for 20 minutes to "Ho Fung College" Bus Stop at Wo Yi Hop Road and take public transport to leave. KMB - 32, 36, 40X, 46P, 46X, 47X, 48X, 73X, 278X, N36, 40P, 46P, 47A, 234C, 273C, 273P, 278P Green Minibus - 94, 312, 403, 403A, 403X, 94S (94S only runs on Sundays and public holidays)

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 7) Shing Mun to Lead Mine Pass
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第七段)城門至鉛鑛坳
transport_start: Take Green Minibus route no. 82 at Shiu Wo Street, Tsuen Wan, to the Pineapple Dam Green Minibus Terminus at Shing Mun Reservoir, or take public transport via the Ho Fung College at Wo Yi Hop Road. Get off at Ho Fung College and walk along the Shing Mun Road for 20 minutes to reach the Pineapple Dam. KMB - 32, 36, 40X, 46P, 46X, 47X, 48X, 73X, 278X, N36, 40P, 46P, 47A, 234C, 273C, 273P, 278P Green Minibus - 94, 312, 403, 403A, 403X, 94S (94S only runs on Sundays and public holidays)
transport_end: Continue to MacLehose Trail (Section 8) and leave at Route Twisk, or walk along Wilson Trail Section 7 from Lead Mine Pass for about one and a half hour to Yuen Tun Ha and then take Green Minibus to leave. Green Minibus - 23K and 23S

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 8) Lead Mine Pass to Route Twisk
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第八段)鉛鑛坳至荃錦公路
transport_start: Take off from San Uk Ka or Ta Tit Yan and then walk to Yuen Tun Ha. From Yuen Tun Ha, walk along Wilson Trail (Section 7) for about one and a half hour to Lead Mine Pass Green Minibus route - 23K and 23S
transport_end: Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 51

name_en: MacLehose Trail (Section 9) Route Twisk to Tin Fu Tsai
name_zh: 麥理浩徑(第九段)荃錦公路至田夫仔
transport_start: Take public transport to "Tai Mo Shan Country Park" bus stop. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 51
transport_end: From Tin Fu Tsai, walk for about one and a half hour to Sham Tseng via Tsing Fai Tong. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 52X, 53, 234A and 234B Green Minibus route - 96 and 308M

transport_start: Take public transport to "Nai Chung" bus stop along Sai Sha Road. The Tree Walk is located inside Nai Chung Barbecue Site. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 99, 99X(only runs on Sundays and public holidays) and 299X Green Minibus route - 807B
transport_end: Same as starting point.

transport_start: Get off at Nam Chung Road and walk towards Cheng Uk Tsuen for about 15 minutes to reach the entrance, Arch of Nam Chung Country Trail. Green Minibus route - 56K
transport_end: Walk downhill to depart at the entrance of San Uk Tsai Tsuen. Green Minibus route - 56B

transport_start: Alight at "Nam Shan Campsite" bus stop and walk towards public lavatory. The start point of Tree Walk is next to the start point of Lantau Trail Section 2. New Lantao Bus routes - 1, 2, 3M and 4
transport_end: Return to starting point and take public transport for leaving.

transport_start: Get off at the Ngong Ping Terminus, the entrance of the trail is beside the Bus Terminus. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 21, 23 and 1R (only runs on Sunday and Public Holiday)
transport_end: Visitors can take bus at the Ngong Ping Terminus to depart. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 21 and 23

name_zh: 昂坪自然步道(鳳凰山段)
transport_start: Get off at the Ngong Ping 360 cable car or Ngong Ping Terminus, Ngong Ping Nature Centre is inside Ngong Ping Village. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 23 & 1R (only runs on Sunday and Public Holiday)
transport_end: Retrace the same path from Lantau Peak and leave by Ngong Ping 360 cable car or bus at the Ngong Ping Terminus New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 23 & 1R (only runs on Sunday and Public Holiday)

name_en: Ngong Ping Trail (Nei Lak Shan Section)
name_zh: 昂坪自然步道(彌勒山段)
transport_start: Take the Ngong Ping 360 cable car and alight at “Ngong Ping Cable Car Terminal”, then walk for about 200 m through Ngong Ping Village to the starting point. Alternatively, take the New Lantao Bus to the "Ngong Ping" bus stop, and walk for about 100 m through Ngong Ping Village to the starting point. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 21, 23 and 1R
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk for about 200 m through Ngong Ping Village to the “Ngong Ping Cable Car Terminal” and take the Ngong Ping 360 cable car to leave. Alternatively, walk for about 100 m from the endpoint to the "Ngong Ping" bus stop and depart by New Lantao Bus New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 21, 23 and 1R

transport_start: Get off at the Ngong Ping 360 cable car or Ngong Ping Terminus, Ngong Ping Nature Centre is inside Ngong Ping Village. New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 23 & 1R (only runs on Sunday and Public Holiday)
transport_end: Take Lantau Trail (Section 4) to return to the starting point and leave by Ngong Ping 360 cable car or bus at the Ngong Ping Terminus New Lantao Bus routes - 2, 23 & 1R (only runs on Sunday and Public Holiday)

transport_start: Take public transport to "Pak Tam Chung" bus stop. The entrance of the trail is located behind the Pak Tam Chung Coach Parking area. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 33R, 74R, 94 and 96R (33R, 74R and 96R only run on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9
transport_end: Walk along Pak Tam Road to "Tsak Yue Wu" bus stop. Then take public transport for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 94 and 96R (96R only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9

transport_start: Take public transport to "Sheung Yiu" bus stop and walk along Tai Mong Tsai Road for about 3 minutes to Fuk Hing Bridge, or take green minibus and alight at Fuk Hing Bridge, where the start point locates. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94,96R (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays.) and 289R (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays at 7:00 - 13:30) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9
transport_end: Return from Sheung Yiu along the same route back to the start point and leave. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94, 96R (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays.) and 289R (only runs on Saturdays, Sundays & public holidays at 13:15 - 18:45) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9

transport_start: Take public transport to "Pak Tam Chung" bus stop. Take another 5 minutes walk to the Pak Tam Chung Barbecue site for Handicap where you will see the Pak Tam Chung Tree Walk. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 33R, 74R, 94 and 96R (33R, 74R and 96R only run on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7 and 9
transport_end: Same as starting point.

name_en: Pak Tam Chung to Biu Tsim Kok Hiking Trail
name_zh: 北潭涌至標尖角遠足徑
transport_start: Take public transport to Pak Tam Chung. The start point is after the gate. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 33R, 74R, 94, 96R and 289R (33R, 74R, 96R and 289R only run on Saturdays, Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7, 9 and 9A (9A only runs on Saturday, Sundays & Public Holidays)
transport_end: Walk back to Tai Mong Tsai Road and take public transport for leaving. On Sundays and public holidays, visitors can take green minibus route 9A from East Dam to Pak Tam Chung. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94, 96R and 289R (96R and 289R only runs on Sundays & Public Holidays) Green Minibus routes - 7, 9 and 9A (9A only runs on Saturday, Sundays & Public Holidays)

transport_start: Take bus and get off at “Pak Tam Au” bus stop and walk along Pak Tam Road towards Pak Tam Chung for 3 minutes to reach the start point, or take green minibus at Sai Kung to reach the start point directly. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94 & 96R (96R runs on Sundays & public holidays only) Green Minibus route - 7
transport_end: Walk along Pak Tam Road toward Pak Tam Chung for 5 minutes to reach bus stop or take green minibus at end point. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 94 & 96R (runs on Sunday & public holiday only) Green Minibus route - 7 and 9

transport_start: Take public transport to Tai Mei Tuk Bus Terminus and walk towards Bride's Pool Road for about 10 minutes uphill to reach entrance at the front of the road beside Tai Mei Tuk Country Park Management Centre. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 75K and 275R (275R only runs on Sunday and public holiday) Green Minibus route - 20C and 20R
transport_end: Walk along Bride's Pool Road towards Plover Cove Reservoir to return to Tai Mei Tuk Country Park Management Centre, and then walk downhill to Tai Mei Tuk Bus Terminus for leaving. Take Green Minibus route 20R or bus route 275R (available on Sundays & public holidays only) at Bride's Pool Bus Stop for leaving. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 75K and 275R (275R only runs on Sunday and public holiday) Green Minibus route - 20C and 20R

name_zh: 爐峰自然步道(西高山段)
transport_start: Walk along Peak Road towards Peak Tower after arriving the Peak. The starting point is the entrance of Lugard Road. The Peak Tram Citybus routes - X15, 15 and 15B Green Minibus route - 1
transport_end: Walk along Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road for about 10 minutes to Pok Fu Lam Road and take public transport for leaving. Citybus routes - A10, NA10, 4, 4X, 7, 30X, 37A, 40, 40M, 71, 90B, 91, 970, 970X and 973 Green Minibus routes - 22, 22S, 23, 23M, 31 and 63

name_zh: 爐峰自然步道(松林砲台段)
transport_start: Take the Peak Tram to the Peak Tower or take public transport to the public transport terminus at the Peak, then walk along Peak Road to the starting point at Lugard Road. Citybus routes - X15 and 15 Green Minibus route - 1
transport_end: Take public transport from Kotewall Road to leave. Citybus route – 13 Green Minibus route - 3

transport_start: Take the green minibus route no. 82 at Tsuen Wan Shiu Wo Street to Shing Mun Reservoir. Visitors can also take the bus route via the Ho Fung College at Wo Yi Hop Road and walk uphill along Shing Mun Road for 20 minutes to reach the Pineapple Dam Green Minibus Terminus. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 32, 36, 40X, 46P, 46X, 47X, 48X, 73X, 278X, N36, 40P, 46P, 47A, 234C, 273C, 273P, 278P Green Minibus routes - 94, 312, 403, 403A, 403X, 94S (94S only runs on Sundays and public holidays)
transport_end: Walk along Shing Mun forest track for about 20 minutes back to Pineapple Dam and take the Green Minibus route no. 82 or take bus at Ho Fung College Bus Stop. Transportation information is the same as Start Point.

transport_start: Take the Peak Tram to the Peak Tower or take public transport to reach the public transport terminus at the Peak, then walk along Harlech Road for about 1 km until you reach the junction of Harlech Road and Hatton Road. Turn right to Hatton Road and hike for about 650 m to reach the starting point. Citybus routes - X15 and 15 Green Minibus route - 1
transport_end: From the endpoint, walk for about 1 km along Hatton Road to Kotewall Road, where you can take public transport to leave. Citybus route – 13 Green Minibus route – 3

transport_start: Ferry Service - Ma Liu Shui Ferry Pier to Tung Ping Chau Wong Ye Kok Ferry Pier (Depart from Ma Liu Shui Ferry Pier at 9:00 and 15:30 on Saturdays and 9:00 on Sundays only)
transport_end: Ferry Service- Tung Ping Chau Wong Ye Kok Ferry Pier to Ma Liu Shui Ferry Pier (Depart from Ping Chau Wong Ye Kok Pier at 17:15 on Saturdays and Sundays Only)

transport_start: Get off at Wu Kau Tang Minibus Terminus or Bride's Pool Bus Terminus and walk to Wu Kau Tang. Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) route - 275R (275R only runs on Sunday and public holiday) Green Minibus route - 20R
transport_end: Return to the Tai Mei Tuk bus station Kowloon Motor Bus (KMB) routes - 75K and 275R (275R only runs on Sunday and public holiday) Green Minibus route - 20C

transport_start: Take public transport to "Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road" bus stop. Alight and walk along the Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road for 5 minutes to reach the entrance of the trail beside the Country Park Pok Fu Lam Management Centre. Citybus routes - A10, NA10, 4, 4X, 7, 30X, 37A, 40, 40M, 71, 90B, 91, 970, 970X and 973 Green Minibus routes - 22, 22S, 23, 23M, 31 and 63
transport_end: Same as start point.

transport_start: Walk along Peak Road towards Peak Tower after arriving the Peak. The start point is the entrance of Lugard Road. The Peak Tram Citybus route - X15, 15, 15B Green Minibus route - 1
transport_end: Same as start point.

transport_start: Get off at "Cape Collinson" bus stop, then walk about 70 m to the Shek O Country Park signpost; or get off at "Shek O Road" minibus stop, then walk about 400 m to the Shek O Country Park signpost. Walk up the stone steps on the left and walk about 1.6 km along the "Hong Kong Forest Track – Mount Collinson Section" to the starting point. Citybus route - 9 Green Minibus routes - 16A, 16M, 16X

Green minibus route – 59K Please note that starting from 24 January 2025, the Government opened a specified section of road within the Frontier Closed Area (FCA) near Lin Ma Hang Village (Wang Lek to the entrance of the Lin Ma Hang Village), by exempting the requirement to apply for a Closed Area Permit for the public travelling by green minibus passing through that section of road. Visitors can travel to and from Lin Ma Hang Village and Robin’s Nest Country Park directly by green minibus through the abovementioned section of road within the FCA. The exemption is only applicable to persons travelling by green minibus through that section of road within the FCA, but does not apply to those taking private vehicles, taxis or other vehicles, or using other means of travel such as walking or cycling, without a valid Closed Area Permit. Visitors who would like to travel to and from Lin Ma Hang Village on foot may use the connecting path next to the FCA. The connecting path is a hillside footpath outside the FCA. It takes about 20 minutes of uphill and downhill hike. For more information on the opening of the FCA near Lin Ma Hang Village, please refer to the relevant press release .
